what: Explorer links, and what the website's own permalink.js / deep-link.js parse each to: the canonical query and the view, or a refusal. fractal-engine's link module is held to every row by link::tests::the_parsers_are_the_sites. Regenerated by running `generator` under node with the fractal-website checkout as its one argument.
